name: Innocence
overview: Scripture portrays innocence as a state marked by integrity, trust in the Lord, and freedom from presumptuous sin, as seen in Psalms 19:13 and 26:1 where the psalmist seeks to remain upright and innocent before God. Innocence also involves resisting the pressure to conform to evil, as Exodus 23:2 warns against following the crowd in wrongdoing. Furthermore, Jesus highlights the innocence of children as a model for entering the kingdom of God, inviting them to come to Him without hindrance in Matthew 19:14, Mark 10:14, and Luke 18:16.
